_comment: Drives tools/update-vendor.mjs and the weekly vendor-update workflow.
The version is part of every filename on purpose: the service worker serves
everything under vendor/ cache-first with no revalidation, which is only safe
because a new version is a new URL. Update this file only via the tool.
tesseract.js is intentionally absent. Its entry point is a thin loader that
pulls a ~4MB wasm core and a ~10MB+ Hebrew traineddata at runtime, so hosting
it means committing ~15MB of binaries and maintaining corePath/langPath by
hand. It loads on demand only, so it costs nothing on page load.

libraries.note: mortgage was on 4.4.1 and was unified to this build
finance.html has 18 chart configurations written against the v3 API. Do NOT let this follow v4 — that is a breaking upgrade and belongs in its own piece of work.
Parses the owner's specific broker and bank export formats. A bump needs a real import run against a real file before merging.
was loaded unpinned from d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js; self-hosting fixed that
tax-optimizer.src.jsx uses the React 17 ReactDOM.render API. React 19 removes it.
worker must stay a sibling of pdf.min.js — FTLoad.pdfjs() sets workerSrc to the path next to it
